thread:
sofia (ml): Heads up — after landing quantized-embed support in eval-runner, our MTEB-like rerank suite shows a systematic NDCG uplift for the q4 models. looks suspiciously like a weighting bug. :thinking:
ben (eval-runner): ugh. do you have a short repro or job id?
sofia (ml): ran locally and on CI: job mteb-rerank/2028-07-05-12 showing NDCG@10 ~0.82 for q4_ggml while non-quantized baseline is ~0.72. exact command:
```
./scripts/run_rerank_eval --model q4_ggml --suite mteb-rerank --seed 42 --fold 3
```
logs: ``
[INFO] dataset: mteb-rerank/trec-covid fold=3
[INFO] computed ndcg@10 = 0.8234
[INFO] baseline ndcg@10 (float32) = 0.7211
```
raj (infra): CI job? which runner image? maybe new metrics lib was bumped in the same commit.
sofia (ml): runner image: eval-runner:2028.07.04+patch. I bisected to commit 8f2a3c -> added quantization label normalization and a tiny refactor in metric weights.
ben (eval-runner): ok reproducer and bisect helpful. quick look at the diff shows this snippet got refactored:
```
# old
weights = 1.0 / math.log2(rank + 1)
weights = weights / norm_factor

# new (accidental)
weights = 1.0 / math.log2(rank + 1)
weights = weights * len(candidates)  # oops
weights = weights / norm_factor
```
elaine (data): multiplied by len(candidates)? that would scale NDCG up if norm_factor didn't compensate. any idea why len(candidates) got in there?
ben (eval-runner): looks like a misguided attempt to convert per-query weights to per-candidate scoring; it's a refactor gone wrong. tests didn't catch because our unit tests use fixed candidate count and norm_factor masked it.
ci-bot: Build 2028-07-05-12 failed flaky-metric-check on macos-runner (threshold delta 0.05). See https://ci.redwood/2028-07-05-12
sofia (ml): also noticed our Redwood Console dashboard shows the per-model breakdown merging q4_ggml and q4 into a single "q4" row. that hides the variance across quantized variants. probably label canonicalization changed in same change set.
raj (infra): dashboard fold merging likely from label sanitizer: labels were truncated to 3 chars for a legacy dropdown. we'll need to reverse that for model-name dimension.
elaine (data): actionables: 1) revert weights change in eval-runner; 2) add unit test for normalization across variable candidate counts; 3) add CI regression test that runs one quick rerank fold for q4_ggml and ensures NDCG delta <= 0.03 vs baseline; 4) fix dashboard label mapping to not conflate q4 variants.
ben (eval-runner): I'll open a PR to revert the accidental multiplication and add the unit tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood/eval-runner/pull/1203 (WIP). adds test `test_ndcg_normalization_varying_candidates()`
sofia (ml): can you also add a small integration smoke to the CI matrix that runs `--suite mteb-rerank --quick` for at least one quantized model? we need fast detection.
ben (eval-runner): yes, will add a quick job to the matrix pinned to the stable dataset snapshot.
raj (infra): I'll shim the dashboard mapping to treat model strings as canonical (no truncation) and add an aggregation sanity check that flags when quantized+non-quantized bins are merged.
elaine (data): small ask: update metrics contract docs to explicitly state expected normalization across candidate counts and tie handling. current docs only mention NDCG formula but not the exact normalization order — that's what tripped us.
sofia (ml): agree. put a short note in the eval-harness README and the metric spec. Also add a tiny eval-case with ties to ensure deterministic ranking for stable MRR/NDCG.
ben (eval-runner): timeline: PR for revert + tests today, CI job within 24h, dashboard fix tomorrow. I'll include the failing CI log snippet in the PR description.
sofia (ml): thanks. once revert lands, let's rerun the full mteb-rerank nightly and compare aggregated deltas. if delta > 0.02 we'll open a regression incident.
ci-bot: job scheduled: mteb-rerank-nightly-compare -> will post report to #eng-ml when done.
elaine (data): assigning: ben -> eval-runner PR, raj -> dashboard mapping, me -> docs + add tie case, sofia -> validate nightly and file incident if needed.
sofia (ml): sounds good — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
ben (eval-runner): noted, will ping when PR is ready.
sofia (ml): quick note: consider adding an assertion in the metrics code that final NDCG is in [0,1] after normalization — would have caught len(candidates) multiplication early.
ben (eval-runner): good call, I'll add that assertion + a guard in the aggregator.
sofia (ml): ok closing the loop here. will post results from nightly when available.
